text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, everybody! Pull that shrine<n>with all your
might!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And a one, two, hup!

text_block_list.name: Mikoshi Carriers
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy. It really won't budge, huh.<n>Well this isn't
going to plan...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Fleetfoot Festival,<n>and Tamamo
Cross and Inari One are<n>leading the mikoshi shrine
procession.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's a lot heavier than I thought. It<n>feels like we're
trying to move a<n>tank.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You know what, Ardan, don't even<n>worry about it.
All we need is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Some elbow grease!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now hang on, Inari. All the elbow<n>grease in the
world isn't gonna help<n>unless we're all on the
same page.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's movin' out of sync.<n>What we really
need is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To talk to 'em one by one. Just like<n>you do with
little ones.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey Ardan, what's up? What's<n>gotcha troubled?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I was just assessing the<n>situation, and I
realized that I really<n>need to synchronize with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're overthinkin' it. If ya try and<n>adapt to
everyone else, you'll always<n>be one step behind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just go with whatever feels natural!<n>Don't worry,
it'll all come together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo, I have the opposite problem.<n>I always end
up going too fast for<n>everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah right, you do martial arts,<n>don'cha? You're
probably focusin'<n>too hard!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to move like a<n>lightnin' bolt or
anythin'! Just take it<n>easy and pause a bit after
each step.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: As for you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll get ya somethin' to eat once<n>we're done!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right! I think I've got this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Okay, we've got it this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And a one, two, hup!

text_block_list.name: Mikoshi Carriers
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, way to go, Tama! Just goes to<n>show what
we're capable of when<n>push comes to shove!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, see? Told ya. They just<n>needed a little
helpin' hand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tamamo's thoughtful<n>leadership, the
team unite and lift the<n>shrine with ease.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, how d'ya think we should<n>carry this
shrine around? Should we<n>take it easy or have fun
and get<n>rowdy with it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It is a special occasion. The best way<n>to get the
audience excited would be<n>to...
choice_data_list: Get the kids involved in the procession.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Rope in the kids, eh? Good idea. I bet<n>they'd love
that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, kiddos! Gather round! We're<n>gonna show
ya how to carry the<n>festival shrine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's it, good job. Now tense up<n>your belly a bit
more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's all about your breath. Imagine<n>you're becoming
one with the<n>mikoshi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, grab onto the shrine, not my hair,<n>okay? Let's
stay focused, now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's like you're at one with the<n>gods! Nice
work, guys!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you were right, Trainer. This is<n>the best way
to get everyone<n>together, havin' fun!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I should take a pic for the kiddos back<n>in Osaka.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, Inari. Bring all the little ones<n>'round here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: (Click!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Through her calm interaction with the<n>children,
Tamamo Cross learns that<n>there's more to
festivals than making<n>a loud spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a mikoshi battle could be fun! Not<n>bad, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone! Let's see which<n>team is the
strongest and fastest at<n>carryin' the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! Sounds like a plan!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You've changed your tune, though,<n>Tama. Just a
second ago, you were a<n>gentle teacher, and now
you're all<n>fired up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course. I had to be calm and explain<n>things first so
we could get together<n>and win the battle!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm 'bout to show ya some Naniwa<n>guts! Everyone
pull the floooat!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's... not a float. But that doesn't<n>stop Tamamo
Cross from going wild<n>and having a blast at the fall
festival.
